summary: Stock and delivery information block for Buy Box with conditional display rules.
features: Multiple information items with individual configuration
Manual or dynamic data source options
shortDescription: The Stock & Delivery Information block displays product availability and shipping details within the Buy Box. Merchants can configure multiple information lines, each pulling from manual entries or dynamic backend data. Conditional rules control when each item appears—for example showing 'In Stock' messaging when inventory is available or 'Ships in 3-5 days' when backordered. This flexibility supports complex fulfillment scenarios while keeping customers informed.
